data.availability_clock: Tardis local_timestamp and completed 100-ms compact state decision_us

economic_mechanism: Freeze the prior completed 120-second external high and low.
Require exactly one liquidity raid and completed reclaim.
Require opposite displacement through the last causal opposing-candle open with aligned aggressive flow as MSS/CISD.
Rest one post-only order at 50% consequent encroachment of the raid-to-MSS displacement leg.
A single standardized multinomial logistic model predicts no full fill, fill then target, or fill then stop/boundary loss.
Authorize only positive expected net basis points at the fixed 12-bp primary cost.

execution.queue_rule: displayed same-price queue plus full research quantity must be consumed by actual opposing aggressive trades; cancellations never reduce queue ahead
execution.stop: one tick beyond completed raid extreme
execution.winner_removal: exclude top 10% positive 12-bp event keys before chronological rerouting

model.authorization: event-specific expected net basis points strictly greater than zero at 12 bp; no probability threshold grid

classes.0: no full fill or structural cancel
classes.2: full fill then stop or boundary loss

objective: Test one ML-routed SMC/ICT post-only path that changes the cost and entry-location structure rather than adding another directional strategy.
retirement: Zero survivors retire the entire information unit without model, feature, event, CE, queue, cost, risk or leverage tuning.
